stories.title: Number in temporary housing in Flintshire up 88% in under three years as Wales total falls
stories.summary: The number of people living in temporary accommodation in Flintshire has risen by 88% in less than three years, while the total across Wales has fallen. Welsh Government figures show 563 homeless people were in temporary housing in Flintshire at the end of August 2026. At the end of October 2023 the figure was 300.

stories.title: School leaders across Wales vote for strike action in pay and funding dispute
stories.summary: School leaders across Wales have voted for industrial action, including strike action, in a dispute over pay, funding and workload. stories.title: Five new crossings planned on A548 between Greenfield and Walwen
stories.summary: Five new crossings are planned on and around the A548 Bagillt Road between Greenfield and Walwen. stories.title: Walk-in flu jab clinics open across north Wales from 1 December
stories.summary: Eligible adults and pre-school children in north Wales can walk in to a community clinic for their NHS flu vaccine without an appointment from Tuesday 1 December, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has said.
